page.overview:
Who is Avandros?

Avandros was a female archdruid of the Dawn Circle. In the adventure hook Shard of the Shadebarrow, a wraith claiming to be the spirit of Avandros animated an army of ghasts and ghouls and conquered the Silvercut Crossroads. This adventure hook appears in both the Critical Role: Tal'Dorei Campaign Setting sourcebook, set in 812 PD, and the Tal'Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, set in 836 PD.

So far, Avandros has not appeared or been mentioned onstream.
